name: myeloperoxidase

function.text: MPO encodes myeloperoxidase [Cleaved into: Myeloperoxidase; 89 kDa myeloperoxidase; 84 kDa myeloperoxidase; Myeloperoxidase light chain; Myeloperoxidase heavy chain; 38 kDa myeloperoxidase; 22 kDa myeloperoxidase]. Annotated molecular activities include peroxidase activity and thiocyanate peroxidase activity. It participates in defense response and nucleosome disassembly.

function.text: MPO encodes myeloperoxidase. It promotes NET formation by mediating chromatin disassembly: translocates to the nucleus and specifically binds to nucleosomes, both as monomer and homodimer, leading to nucleosome unstacking and initial chromatin decondensation.
